RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias will harm your professional reputation. Demographic composition alone is not proof of discrimination, just as an all-male panel does not inherently indicate bias.

For a group head role, commercial acumen, client relationships, and leadership fit often carry more weight than extra years of technical design experience once baseline credentials (such as chartered status) are met. Additionally, two weeks is a typical corporate delay for written HR feedback.

Do not bring up the panel's gender. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused on how you can strengthen your client-facing and leadership competencies for future executive roles.
